description: Defines classes and constants for DVB broadcast descriptors such as NetworkName, SatelliteDeliverySystem, CableDeliverySystem, and Service within the Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::Descriptors namespace.

classes.name: NetworkName
classes.description: Represents a network name descriptor with a method to retrieve the name string.

classes.name: SatelliteDeliverySystem
classes.description: Represents satellite delivery system descriptor with methods to access frequency, modulation, symbol rate, and FEC.

classes.name: CableDeliverySystem
classes.description: Represents cable delivery system descriptor with methods to access frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC, and FEC outer.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service descriptor with methods to access service type, provider, and name.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the network name as a string.

methods.name: Provider
methods.description: Returns the service provider as a string.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the service name as a string.
